name: Embat
description: Query your cash, debt, treasury forecasts, accounting, PSP reconciliations, payments, and intercompany positions in plain language — answered with your real numbers from Embat. TellMe is read-only and inherits your existing permissions, so every reply is scoped to what you can already see. Make your treasury management system a native part of your AI workflow, without leaving the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Embat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Embat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://tellme.embat.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Embat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Embat provides these MCP tools: ask_tellme.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Embat?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Embat in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Embat requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Embat is developed by Embat. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
